### Wait Upon the Lord
Author: Billy Graham
Site: Billy Graham Evangelistic Association
URL: https://billygraham.org/devotions/wait-upon-the-lord
Passage: Psalm 105:3-4
Points:
- Daily quiet time alone with God is essential to sustain spiritual vitality.
- Immersing oneself in Scripture feeds the soul and prevents the Christian life from becoming a desert.
- Seeking and waiting upon the Lord renews personal strength to run without growing weary.

### The Face of God
Author: Marybeth Whalen
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-june-14-2006-1402354.html
Passage: Psalm 105:4
Points:
- Seeking God's face means training one's ears to hear His gentle whisper above life's noise.
- Believers can pray with confidence knowing the Lord listens attentively and answers their cries.
- God's watchful eyes never lose sight of His children, comforting them in difficult moments.
- Sincere worship and praise rise as a pleasing aroma before God's throne.

### Hold On to God’s Hand
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-march-2-3-2013.html
Passage: Psalm 105:4
Points:
- Embracing God's will requires letting go of the familiar and risking the unknown future.
- Human beings have finite perspective and are easily frightened by what lies ahead.
- Holding onto God's hand and trusting His direction calms internal fears.
- Living in the center of God's mysterious plan remains the safest place to be.
